name: CA-08
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent John Garamendi running with large financial advantage
Prediction markets price Democratic win at ~96%
model.rationale: Garamendi holds a D+19 district with a twelve-to-one fundraising edge and no outside spending against him, while Recile has raised under $9,000. Markets and fundamentals both point to an easy incumbent win, so the forecast stays at a roughly 24-point Democratic margin.
model.watch: A surprise influx of outside spending against Garamendi or a major incumbent scandal would be the only realistic path to narrowing this race.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
California's 8th district leans heavily Democratic, with a partisan advantage of about 19 points, and veteran incumbent John Garamendi is seeking another term. He has raised roughly $489,000 and holds more than $1.1 million in cash, while Republican Rudy Recile has raised under $9,000 and reports only about $1,500 on hand. No outside groups are spending in the race, and no expert raters list it as competitive.

Prediction markets put Garamendi's chances around 96 percent, and the fundamentals point to a margin in the mid-20s. With no public polling and a minimally funded challenger, the race is rated Safe Democratic, with Garamendi expected to win comfortably.
